title: Binance Reportedly Hacked as Attackers Steal Up to $5.7 Billion in Cryptocurrency
content_md: Binance has suspended deposits and withdrawals due to a security incident. Early estimates from blockchain tracking indicated that attackers may have drained as much as $5.7 billion in cryptocurrency. The exchange has committed to covering all losses while investigators work to trace the transactions and coordinate asset freezes throughout the cryptocurrency ecosystem.
